mia (DR coordinator): postmortem follow-up check. Noticed repeating pattern across last 4 drills: routing convergence + snapshot restore flakiness. We need consolidated owners and a single remediation tracker.

oz (SRE): confirmed. The newest log sample shows kube-proxy conntrack exhaustion during restore job spikes. That exacerbates route churn.

jess (EngInfra): my read: heavy restore I/O + control-plane ops causes node-level pressure which leads to pod restarts. We should add resource limits to restore jobs and backpressure on restore clients.

nate (Platform): agree. propose: 1) make restores rate-limited client-side; 2) add resource requests/limits to restore job; 3) improve dashboard. Break into tickets.

mia (DR coordinator): list items below, add owner + ETA and create JIRA links here. I'll be the tracker.

A) Restore client backpressure + rate-limit (short). owner: nate. ETA: 4d (2180200000).

B) Restore job resource requests/limits + QoS class (short). owner: jess. ETA: 5d (2180250000).

C) Kube-proxy conntrack tuning + monitoring (medium). owner: oz. ETA: 10d (2180600000).

D) Consolidated DR tracker + postmortem note (short). owner: mia. ETA: 2d (2180180000).

E) Game-day: run a drill where we intentionally delay snapshot backend responses to validate circuit-breaker behavior. owner: ops. ETA: schedule in next 2 weeks.

sla-bot: checklist: backpressure(nate) | job_qos(jess) | conntrack(oz) | tracker(mia) | game_day(ops).

nate (Platform): I'll implement a token-bucket limiter in the restore client library, default 5 concurrent restores per cluster, and a config flag for canary. Creating ENG-OPS-2005.

jess (EngInfra): I'll add requests/limits and change restore job to Guaranteed QoS when possible. Creating ENG-INF-2130.

oz (SRE): conntrack tuning: increase max to 262144, add eviction alerts. Creating ENG-SRE-1555.

mia (DR coordinator): created ENG-DR-1415 (consolidated tracker + postmortem note). Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-DR-1415

nate (Platform): created ENG-OPS-2005 (restore client rate-limit). Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-OPS-2005

jess (EngInfra): created ENG-INF-2130 (restore job QoS). Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-INF-2130

oz (SRE): created ENG-SRE-1555 (conntrack tuning + alerts). Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-SRE-1555

mia (DR coordinator): please add short owners note into the consolidated postmortem: "Recurring pattern: concurrent heavy restores cause node control-plane pressure -> conntrack exhaustion -> route churn -> increased restore latency/failures." Keep it brief.

nate (Platform): will canary the limiter to 10% of restores.

jess (EngInfra): will include Helm values and helmfile PR link in tracker.

oz (SRE): will add a small Grafana dashboard and an alert if conntrack_usage > 80%.

mia (DR coordinator): thanks. I'll hold a 15m sync Fri to verify PR links and the game-day date. :calendar:
